content.text: The instructions never say whether `--exclude` prunes whole directories (vendor/, build/) or only matches leaf file paths/basenames — I didn't test it since it wasn't needed; I filtered vendor/build hits out of the unrestricted `--grep` results myself. The read-spec grammar allows chaining plain ranges with a comma in one spec (`6-,-3`, `1-3,10-13`), which worked, but the instructions never disambiguate that comma from the comma inside `/from/,/to/` — it's not obvious both are legal in the same address language until tried. Task 9's expected failure mode (write plan using `-2`, "not -M") isn't given an exit code in the text; empirically it's a parse error (exit 2), not a per-hunk refusal (exit 1). Task 8's ambiguous-pattern case likewise isn't given an exit code; empirically it's exit 1 ("nothing written"). Nothing else was unclear; all instructed forms (`N-`, `-M`, `A,+N` via context, `$`, pattern ranges, `--grep`, `-C`) behaved as documented.
